blocks.text: Step into the world of Diamond Artistry, an oasis of bridal beauty nestled  in the heart of Kilpauk, Chennai. With a decade of experience, we stand  as pioneers in the industry in South India, dedicated to transforming  bridal hair and makeup experiences.

As bridal makeup experts, we  specialize in curating looks that seamlessly blend sophistication and  elegance, ensuring that your special day is adorned with timeless  beauty. Our commitment goes beyond the brush – we offer comprehensive  styling services, extending our expertise to help you with jewelry and  outfit selections. Located in the center of the city, Kilpauk, we strive  to make our studio convenient and accessible for brides seeking the  epitome of beauty on their wedding day. Our team is a collective of  experts and specialists in makeup, hair and draping, working  harmoniously to bring your vision to life. Before the big day, we invite you to a personalized consultation session, where your dreams meet our  expertise in a collaborative journey towards your perfect bridal look. At Diamond Artistry, we don't just provide a service; we craft an experience.
Let us be a part of your wedding journey, where a decade of excellence meets the artistry of your dreams.
I've been following her in insta for a long time and I wanted her to do my makeup on my big day. What can I say...  Class is the only word we need to say. 😊
Not too much, not too less, just Perfect!!!
Her makeup was flawless and long lasting!! It stood for more than 8 hours 😊
Should say her calm and caring personality keeps all her brides cool. It was wonderful to have her. Thank you Salomi and your team, and your hair stylist dor making my big day awesome!!  😊❤️

Absolutely recommended for bridal make up! 
Salomi and her team exactly delivered what I wanted on my big day! From a person who wears no more than a kajal to someone who wore professional make up for the first time, I don’t think I have felt so confident about myself. 
The best part about her work, you look extremely natural post make up! Special thanks to Bhavani and Menaka for completing the look! 
Thanks again guys !
I cannot say enough about Salomi and her very talented team, DIAMOND ARTISTRY!

I had the pleasure of having Salomi do makeup for my sister and I for my wedding on July 3rd. Let me start off by saying that I had booked her for my engagement as well and I was NEVER disappointed. Salomi is nothing short of AMAZING!! She is extremely talented, friendly, funny, caring, and takes pride in her work. Her main goal REALLY IS to make sure that YOU feel BEAUTIFUL and she always come through. I had booked her AIRBRUSH package and it was worth EVERY penny. Everything she did was FLAWLESS. She worked quickly but efficiently. 
I cannot be happier with how everything turned out. I will always recommend her for ANY event and will absolutely continue booking them for my own as well.

I had an amazing experience with Salomi and her team! They scheduled a consultation with me prior to the wedding to understand my preferences/ outfits / jewellery. On the event day, there were punctual, accommodating, calm and just brilliant at their work

My makeup was perfectly done to enhance my features - it was natural and flawless. Eternally grateful to them for making me look like myself on the most important day of my life :)
We never regretted for choosing Salomi & team diamond artistry for my sister’s wedding. They were on time to the venue, very professional and friendly.
For my sister’s engagement, Loki did makeup for bride & Yuvrani did hairdo. We really loved the look. And for bridesmaid Lakshmi did no-makeup makeup look♥️♥️. Everyone appreciated the looks.
And for my sister’s wedding, Salomi & her assistants did brides makeup & for bridesmaid Indhu & Loki did hair/makeup. Bride looked like a model with the hair & makeup in her reception look ♥️♥️  .
Thanks Salomi, Loki, Indhu, Bhavani, praveena, Yuvrani & team.
Special mention to Reethika, she was the one who coordinated with us & team very well. She acted as bridge between us to make the event more exciting & memorable. Thanks Reethika.

I'm a person who wears no makeup at all and  I was overwhelmed with the idea of bridal makeup. Nobody ever likes me with makeup simply because it makes me look so different. On my wedding day, i mentioned all my concerns to Salomi. She then did her magic   
I was so happy with the way i looked and with the fact that i looked like myself. She kept it so natural and minimal. I'm very glad I picked Salomi for my special day.

Salomi did an amazing job and she’s a perfectionist when it comes to her work. Her make up did not budge and is very creative. She works with the client’s preference and really makes the client comfortable and at ease.
I really would love to get dolled up by her again. ❤️

A Pioneer in the Makeup Industry, known for championing looks given to them. Six years in the Industry has earned us an array of loyal clients.
 
Salomi Diamond has been exalted for her signature no makeup, flawless, glowing skin look.

At  Diamond Artistry, we envision a world where every bride feels radiantly  confident, embodying timeless elegance on one of the most cherished  days of her life. Our vision is to be the premier destination for bridal  makeup services, where each stroke of our artistry enhances natural  beauty and creates lasting memories.

Our  mission at Diamond Artistry is to curate unparalleled bridal  experiences through the art of makeup. We are dedicated to providing  exceptional, personalized services that capture the essence of each  bride's individual style and personality. With a commitment to  creativity, precision, and a touch of magic, we strive to make every  bride feel not just beautiful but authentically herself as she walks  down the aisle. Your journey to forever begins with Diamond Artistry,  where dreams meet reality in the most exquisite way.
